title: A2ATaskTicket
description: Schema for asynchronous task tickets between Orchestrator and Worker Agents

ticket_id.description: Unique identifier for this task ticket, e.g. TICKET-20261109-001

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when ticket was dispatched

issuer.description: Name of the orchestrator issuing the task, e.g. Antigravity-Orchestrator

target_worker.description: Target worker entity, e.g. local-ollama, kilo-worker, coder-subagent

action.description: Operation requested, e.g. parse_subtitles, generate_code, lint

payload.description: Parameters and input data for the action
